system.name: Parrot
system.one_liner: an LLM application serving system that exposes Semantic Variables to enable app-centric, cross-request optimization

components.name: Applications (front-end)
components.role: client-side layer where LLM applications are written

components.name: Parrot Front-end
components.role: front-end for programming LLM applications with Semantic Variable annotations

components.name: Parrot APIs w/ Semantic Variables
components.role: API boundary exposing the Semantic Variable abstraction to applications over the Internet

components.name: Parrot Manager w/ Inter-Request Analysis
components.role: server-side manager that performs inter-request analysis to enable cross-request optimizations

components.name: Inter-Request Comm.
components.role: detects and manages communication/dependencies between requests

components.name: Perf. Objective Deduction
components.role: deduces application-level performance objectives from Semantic Variables

components.name: Sharing Prompt Prefix
components.role: identifies and shares common prompt prefixes across requests

components.name: App-centric Scheduling
components.role: schedules requests using application-level context rather than treating requests independently

components.name: Contextual Fill / Gen
components.role: intermediate stage that fills and generates content based on Semantic Variable context

components.name: Parrot LLM Engine
components.role: backend engine layer executing the LLM inference, run as multiple instances

components.name: Context Management
components.role: manages the LLM context (e.g., KV cache/prompt context) for efficient reuse

components.name: Efficient GPU Kernels
components.role: optimized GPU kernels for LLM inference

content.key_idea: Centering on the Semantic Variable abstraction, Parrot Manager performs inter-request analysis (communication, performance-objective deduction, prompt-prefix sharing, app-centric scheduling) between the application front-end and the LLM engine.
content.reading_order: Top to bottom: application front-ends across a dashed Internet boundary into the Parrot App-centric LLM Service, through the Parrot Manager's four analysis sub-modules, then Contextual Fill/Gen, down into the Parrot LLM Engine.

summary: This figure gives Parrot's system overview as a top-down layered stack. At the top, Applications (front-end) includes the Parrot Front-end and compatibility with other frameworks like LangChain; requests cross an Internet boundary via Parrot APIs annotated with Semantic Variables. The Parrot App-centric LLM Service layer contains the Parrot Manager, which performs Inter-Request Analysis through four sub-modules — Inter-Request Comm., Perf. Objective Deduction, Sharing Prompt Prefix, and App-centric Scheduling — then a Contextual Fill/Gen stage feeds the Parrot LLM Engine, shown as multiple stacked instances handling Context Management and Efficient GPU Kernels. Outer containers use a light-blue fill and inner modules a peach fill, with the key terms 'Semantic Variables' and 'Inter-Request Analysis' set in bold dark-orange text to emphasize the paper's core abstraction.
summary_zh: 图6展示Parrot的系统总览：应用前端(含Parrot Front-end及LangChain等兼容框架)通过带Semantic Variables标注的API跨越Internet边界，进入Parrot Manager进行跨请求分析(通信、性能目标推导、公共前缀共享、应用感知调度)，再经Contextual Fill/Gen进入多实例的Parrot LLM Engine，蓝色为分层容器，橙红色文字突出核心抽象。
